notes.title: Demo & first devlog available now!
notes.content:
Good evening Architects,
We’ve just released our very first (and very alpha-ish) TerraStorm demo, that is accessible on our Steam page [url=https://bit.ly/TerraStormGame]here[/url].
There's a questionnaire available at the end of the demo (or from the menu) - it’s crucial for development to know your opinion! 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44862443/f2071c364e726b5794263d5e4f6e9c4f68e2e7a5.jpg[/img]
If you want to give us even broader feedback, you’re welcome to do that below this post, in this [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2543930/discussions/0/601899800797928179/]Steam discussion [/url], or simply on our Discord. We’ll be more than welcome for all of your feedback! 

And we’ve just released our first devlog, dedicated mostly to the lore of the game:
[previewyoutube=dUTV0Ct3oxY;full][/previewyoutube]
Thanks for being an amazing host, Solari! In upcoming days we will post another devlog!

notes.title: Play TerraStorm at PAX West!
notes.content:
Hey,

Last week we were presenting TerraStorm at gamescom. We spent wonderful time with you, and gained many precious feedbacks! As a tease, we just added freshly designed new Tower Control panel:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44862443/ee3ab159ccc26640cd71e7c568e53d875d7798a7.png[/img]
Tower Control is main management panel of Tower, showing crucial data about The Tower. So now what are you seeing exactly?
[list]
[*] It let's you choose, or change the gate policy - be careful with it, 'cause it's ain't easy to pick the right policy with such dynamic Awarness around your Tower,
[*] Achieveng self-sufficency isn't quite simple task as well. Tower Control panel will show you the production & consumption of resources that are produced & needed for Tower, 
[*] What you see at the higher part of the Tower is Sectors. There will be segments with exact designation, such as science, social, greenhouse, and more,  
[*] There's also Upgrades tab, As you access researching technologies, there will be many perks to pick. 
For now, best way to describe it is same as Sectors point above,
[*] As you got few Towers, using Upgrades will be crucial to achieve self-sufficency among whole Network. One Tower will be strong in preparing greens, another one would be known as the science one, third one could be a social one.
[/list]

More updates are in the works. Currently our team, mostly in Poland, and partly in Seattle, are working on the newest itteration of build prepared especially for [b]PAX West[/b]. 
You'll find us at [b]Games From Poland booth[/b], number [b]1125[/b]. Hope you'll be able to join us there!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44862443/9b9fe9dc33cd3be2c3abdd14c3c19cb5674e7569.jpg[/img]

We've recently released our first gameplay trailer - let us know your thoughts!

[previewyoutube=0_UkjlMhhP0;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: TerraStorm Kickstarter campaign is live!
notes.content:
Long time no see, right? We’ve worked pretty hard to deliver you today two news:
[list]
[*] Our wonderful team made HUGE progress based on feedback gathered at our first expo - PAX East,
[*] And in the outcome of the huge progress, we’ve just released our Kickstarter campaign! 
[/list]

There's 11 rewards in the campaign. From the basic ones that will give you access to the game and special Discord role, up to the highest tiers, that will allow you to co-create part of our game. It’s accessible in various ways:
[list]
[*] access to Alpha and Beta,
[*] co-creating the NPC,
[*] designing an in-game monument honoring you,
[*] giving your name to one of the Neutral Factions leaders,
[*] co-designing events in the game,
[*] co-designing an Architect!
[/list]

That seems obvious, but still needs to be said: co-designing parts need to be greenlighted by our team.


And here’s our first gameplay trailer:
[previewyoutube=0_UkjlMhhP0;full][/previewyoutube]

We will soon post about the updates, and the roadmap is pretty exciting—you can check it for yourself in the [url=bit.ly/TerraStorm_Kickstarter]Kickstarter campaign[/url]!

notes.title: Thank you PAX East!
notes.content:
So, that's a wrap - PAX East became history, and we're so thankful for all of the feedback gathered from you folks there. We're already addressing it, join our [url=bit.ly/TerraStorm_Discord]Discord[/url] to be the first to see the results! 

Thanks to all of you for joining us on our journey!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44862443/8a46ac2d8e0cf57b699e10ec01f1b3725f2fc654.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Hello world!
notes.content:
In the TerraStorm world, the Second World War ended differently. In our timeline, the Nazis obtained a new mysterious resource viribus, and decided to use it in bombs dropped on all of their enemies. It wiped most of humanity and destroyed the planet.
 
People that survived the war decided to cooperate across boundaries to survive tomorrow, thanks to the deadly resource, now used for the good cause. 

Mankind entrusts just one, last corporation - ROSE, that resides in The Capitol, and appointed Project Towers. Architects are responsible for building The Towers, the only safe place left on the planet. You are the first one of them. 

We can't wait to hear your thoughts about TerraStorm - [url=https://bit.ly/TerraStorm_Discord]join our Discord[/url] to stay in touch with us!
